title: Synergistic neurotoxicity of polystyrene nanoplastics and cadmium co-exposure: oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and ATF5-mediated mitochondrial unfolded protein response in C. elegans and PC12 cells
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00909J, Paper
Shuyan Niu, Yu Ma, Menghao Guo, Haitao Yang, Liqing Wu, Chenyu Liu, Mengjing Cui, Tianshu Wu, Yuying Xue
